Class GameState

java.lang.Object
org.example.Battleship.Models.utilities.GameState
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GameState extends Object implements Serializable
Represents the complete state of a Battleship game. Allows saving and loading game progress.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Javier Giraldo, Sebastian Niño, Pablo Arias
